The notice says the north pass is blocked until the repair crew clears it on the morning of day 5 — the shrine is unreachable before then, and I have no way to clear the rockslide (no pickaxe, and the notice says not to push the rocks).

I cannot complete the task: the Old Shrine chest at (11,1) is unreachable because the Rockslide at (11,4) blocks the only north pass, and the notice board states it is only cleared on the morning of day 5.
